arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show the result

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specify queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: model
arg.description: Path or URL of the model (onnx) of the same input and output as MiDaS, empty for MiDaS v2.1 small

arg.name: backend
arg.description: Backend of cv::dnn: auto, cpu, opencl, opencl_fp16, cuda or cuda_fp16. auto uses CUDA when OpenCV is built with CUDA and a CUDA device is found, and the CPU otherwise.

arg.name: input_width
arg.description: Width of the network input, 256 for MiDaS v2.1 small

arg.name: input_height
arg.description: Height of the network input, 256 for MiDaS v2.1 small
